purpose: One fixed pair-first feasibility check over the frozen dense TASKA top-8 contacts; this is not a pose model or a solver sweep.
component_definition: realised selected-supply focal-positive connected components from each final confirmed six-arm layout
canonical_group_key: unordered component pair plus one implied integer relative translation
independent_contact_definition: distinct directed physical tile adjacency (source, target, axis)
reciprocity_definition: the physical edge occurs in both the source outgoing top-8 list and the target incoming top-8 list after the same board-feasibility filter used by the frozen cache
axis_consistency_definition: a retained group contains at least one reciprocal right edge and at least one reciprocal down edge
pass_action: Preregister exactly one consensus-supply arm/consumer over confirmed fusion with local pair delta >= 0 and exact delta >= -1.
fail_action: Document stop without constructing or evaluating a solver arm.
